subject: Error in downloading data from Worldclim

messages.subject: Error in downloading data from Worldclim
parts:
Hi everyone, to whom it may concern, I am Wini a master's student who currently doing research. I need climate data to be analyzed which I can get from Worldclim, however, these days the website server appears to be down. I have been trying to access it since 4 days ago, but until now I still get stuck. 
The site (https://geodata.ucdavis.edu/climate/worldclim/2_1/hist/cts4.06/2.5m/wc2.1_cruts4.06_2.5m_tmax_2020-2021.zip) shows "the site can't be reached" even though I've used many devices with different connections. Can anybody help me to solve this? Is this a common issue on the Worldclim website? Will it be back again?

Looking forward to anybody's help and information.
Thank you
